context: Hina-young goes alone for the first time on a train trip to visit Mei.
purpose: Teen taking independence step; phone call with parent.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Mei, I caught the train all by myself!
lines.style: Bright, proud triumph. Quick attack on the opening. Warm and eager — seeking her approval. Slight breathlessness of accomplishment. End on a lift.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: That's wonderful — you did it all on your own.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely delighted. Slow, deliberate delivery. Soft emphasis on 'all on your own' — seeing her courage, not just the action. Tender affirmation in the voice.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ドキドキしたけど、大丈夫。
lines.en: I was nervous, but I'm okay.
lines.style: Honest vulnerability under the surface. Slight hesitation before 'I'm okay' — checking in with herself. Soft, genuine tone. Pride mixed with relief.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 到着したら、連絡してね。
lines.en: Message me when you get there, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, caring instruction without urgency. Quiet concern wrapped in softness — she wants to know she's safe. Trailing slightly upward at the end, inviting reassurance.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah, I will! Wait for me!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick-paced opening. Warm reassurance in her promise. Light, genuine excitement — checking in, seeking connection.
